body:
The VS Code preview is a COMMAND-DRIVEN WebviewPanel, NOT a CustomTextEditor (no registerCustomEditorProvider). The raw file stays in the native editor; filemark.openPreview/openPreviewToSide create a webview panel (one per doc URI, tracked in panels: Map<string,WebviewPanel>). So adding a file type = NOT intercepting opens; just (a) offer the command on it + (b) pick the renderer in the webview.
Data flow: host posts MSG.update with text (document.getText(), live via debounced onDidChangeTextDocument) + fileExt (already in the protocol) + config: PreviewConfig. PreviewConfig (src/shared/messages.ts) + readConfig() (extension.ts) carry filemark.* settings; onDidChangeConfiguration -> repostAll() makes settings live with no extra wiring.
Renderer choice = pure pickPreviewRenderer(ext, viewMode, enableCsv) in src/shared/constants.ts (unit-tested) -> discriminated PreviewRenderer ("markdown"|"github"|"csv"|"csv-disabled"); App.tsx switches on it exhaustively (never default). CSVViewer (@filemark/csv), MDXViewer/GithubMarkdown (@filemark/mdx) all take the same ViewerProps, drop-in.
CSV/TSV support added 2026-08-09, gated by filemark.enableCsv (default true; off -> menus hide + a note shows). Needed: @filemark/csv dep, csv/tsv LANGUAGE contributions in package.json (so the extension activates + when-clauses fire; CSV has no built-in VS Code language), onLanguage:csv/tsv activation, and when clauses `editorLangId == markdown || (config.filemark.enableCsv && editorLangId =~ /^(csv|tsv)$/)` on menus/palette/keybindings (toggleGithubPreview stays markdown-only). Datagrid Tailwind classes already generated: the webview CSS @source glob scans all packages/*/src. To add json/schema later: same shape (dep + pickPreviewRenderer case + language contribution + enable<Format> setting + widen the when regex).
